CHANGE AUDIT: CHANGE-001
• Problem: DEV-PC-01 erroneously cabled to Floor 1 Switch.
• Action: Relocated patch lead to ACC-F2-01:Fa0/1.
• Security: Cleared stale MAC on F1; Enabled Port-Security on F2.
• Validation: 100% ICMP reachability to Core Gateway (10.10.10.1) & Git Server (10.10.60.21).

div.div:
INFRASTRUCTURE DESIGN SPECS
• L2 Bundling: LACP (802.3ad) Active-Active Po1..3
• STP Protocol: Rapid-PVST+ (Sub-2s Failover)
• L3 Forwarding: Centralized SVI on Core 1
• Perimeter: Cisco ASA 5506-X Stateful NAT
• Trunk Allowed: VLAN 10–90, Native VLAN 999

text.tspan: • L3 Forwarding: Centralized SVI on Core 1
